row370.finding: Hides stage_1200, successfully neutralizing the leakage of the medication administration sequence.

producerCheckerAgreement.reason: AGENTS.md delegation rules and DECISIONS.md P2/P5 forbid producer from supplying its own independent checker.

decisionThresholdAssessment.rationale: 4 of the 8 sampled parents (threshold is >= 2) contain parts where the correct clinical and semantic state is baseline-before-first-stage / no valid declared stage. Existing stage IDs cannot represent this state without causing answer leaks or chronological distortion. Scaling the existing R3 repair mechanism is strongly blocked.

singleStageFinding.inspectionSummary: Live evidence in gemini-canonical (e.g. gemini_gap_case_hypertension_lifestyle_02, gemini_gap_case_palliative_care_03) confirms that single-stage cases frequently use global exhibits for baseline admission data while their sole declared stage represents a future follow-up (3 months later, 4 hours later). Forcing answerableAfterStageId to that single declared stage is semantically misleading and conceptually identical to the baseline contract gap in multi-stage cases.

unsupportedPremises: Premise that Tier 1 (single-stage) is semantically sound and deterministic without judgement: Contradicted by single-stage follow-up semantics.
Premise that all anchor omissions can be resolved by selecting a member of caseStudy.stages[].id: Contradicted by 4 of 8 sampled parents lacking any declared stage for baseline.
Premise that no schema amendment is necessary: Contradicted by the absence of any data representation for zero stages visible / baseline answerability.
